campuses.title: Main Campus
campuses.text: Главный кампус 740 акров у Lake Springfield, 6 миль от центра города. Все четыре колледжа: College of Business and Management, College of Health, Science and Technology, College of Liberal Arts and Social Sciences, College of Public Affairs and Education.

paragraphs: University of Illinois Springfield (UIS) is a public university in Springfield, Illinois, founded in 1969 as Sangamon State University. It became the third institution in the University of Illinois System on July 1, 1995. UIS is ranked No. 1 in Illinois and No. 7 in the Midwest among regional universities (2025 rankings) and is accredited by the Higher Learning Commission.

UIS serves approximately 4,364 students across 49 bachelor's, 51 master's, and one doctoral program (DPA Public Administration). The university is organized into four colleges: College of Business and Management (AACSB-accredited), College of Health, Science and Technology, College of Liberal Arts and Social Sciences, and College of Public Affairs and Education.

The 740-acre campus sits adjacent to Lake Springfield, approximately six miles southeast of downtown Springfield — the state capital of Illinois. UIS is recognized for its 95.9% graduate success rate, strong online program portfolio (51 online degrees), and the Capital Scholars Honors Program. The Prairie Stars compete in NCAA Division II athletics.

International students at UIS join a personalized academic environment with dedicated International Student Services. Programs in Public Administration, Cybersecurity, Data Analytics, and Computer Science are particularly strong, drawing students into Illinois' political and policy capital.
